entities.name: Isabelle de Funès
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Isabelle Christine Inès Léonore Girard, better known by the name Isabelle de Funès, is a French actress, singer, model and photographer. She is best known for her portrayal of Guido Crepax's comic book character Valentina in the erotic thriller, Baba Yaga (1973).
